notes: Modified cash basis. Governmental lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Modified Cash Basis - Governmental Funds (Total Governmental Funds column, pp7-8); roll-forward on fund balance (beginning 2,228,417, ending 2,672,560, p8). Loan proceeds 275,000 are under Other Financing Sources (p8) -> debt_proceeds; no governmental transfers printed. No single governmental cash total is printed, so beginning/ending cash are null (as FY2023/FY2024). Business-type lines from the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund (Total Proprietary Funds column, pp11-12; enterprise + internal service); the Enterprise (80,000) / Internal Service 80,000 transfers net to zero in the Total column, so transfers_net is null. Business-type disbursements total = Statement of Activities total business-type expenses 4,445,526 (p3), which equals the proprietary statement's expense lines. Proprietary cash flows null as in FY2023/FY2024 (the schedule of cash flows on p17 is partial: no net change or ending cash printed). Business-type detail from the Enterprise Fund Accounts accrual-basis combining schedules by department (pp15-16; Light, Water, Sewer, Sanitation, Others; Elimination column not recorded), as FY2023/FY2024; it is on a different basis than the modified cash statement and does not tie to it (operating revenues 4,995,894 vs 4,989,014). Governmental detail: General, Debt Service, Special Grants and Reuse fund columns of the governmental funds statement; Street Repair and Maintenance Fund from its own schedule (p14, ties to its column). Special Grants Intergovernmental 261,057 is federal per the budgetary schedule's 'Federal revenues' 261,057 (p13); Grant income 17,154 has no grantor printed (category other / Grants). Vehicle expenses kept generic (page does not establish fuel). Not recorded: the All-Purpose Fund budgetary schedule (p13, one combined column for all funds). Read pages 1-17 of 17.
